title: Vendor / Supplier Master
description: The record for anyone we owe money to: PACCAR itself as parts/warranty payer, an outside sublet shop, or a general trade supplier.
x-api-note: No public Fortellis developer guide for a vendor/AP master API was found; only marketing language confirms a 'Vendor workflow' exists in-DMS, with documentation stated as 'coming soon'.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.

vendor_workflow_record_view_edit_vendor_.description: CDK's own marketing confirms a vendor workflow exists to view/edit vendor info, but no field names are published

oem_vendor_classification_flag.description: Dealer-accounting convention treats OEM parts/warranty payables as flowing through the AP vendor master, but CDK has no documented flag distinguishing OEM from other vendors

sublet_vendor_classification_flag.description: Sublet (outside vendor) labor is a standard dealer-accounting concept but has no documented CDK vendor-record flag

corpay_payment_processor_integration_ref.description: CDK Heavy Truck integrates a Corpay connection specifically 'to simplify vendor payments and boost AP efficiency' — direct evidence a vendor/AP record exists and is externally addressable
corpay_payment_processor_integration_ref.x-source-title: CDK Global Heavy Truck — OEM & ISV Integrations

accounts_payable_module_foundations_suit.description: CDK's Foundations Suite advertises an 'Accounts Payable' module with 'multicompany Accounting' and seamless data flow from Sales and Service into Accounting

three_way_match_po_receipt_vendor_invoic.description: No CDK-specific public documentation confirms a native three-way match inside CDK Drive AP; competitor Karmak explicitly advertises this for PACCAR parts invoices, which is indirect evidence dealers expect it
